decision: Owner-directed second look after the Nanoda screen closed NO_SIGNAL. Defer E0-RPYLEAN-RECURSOR-RULE-ARGUMENT-VALIDATION-1 because reproducing Arena #350's public rpylean failure as a standalone endpoint adds little. Select RPYLEAN-RECURSOR-RULE-ARGUMENT-REPAIR-1 READY and unstarted: use the public case only as a failing baseline, implement the smallest semantically justified constructor-derived argument check, add a direct regression, run upstream tests and retain a local patch and PR draft. No external write is authorized. Keep assurance-companion and checked-import packaging work DEFERRED.

categories.assessment: The next useful method is implementation with fault-sensitive validation, not another known-case screen. A repair can answer whether rpylean can reject the published wrong-argument rule while preserving honest dependent and recursive rules in an explicit supported fragment.

Arena #350 supplies the public semantic oracle and current source supplies the validation-to-reduction path. The selected repair must retain exact baseline/control bytes, patch identity and supported-shape limits. Missing historical cloud evidence is unrelated and remains WAITING.

Current rpylean main still documents the gap and narrow issue/pull-request searches found no public repair. A tested local patch has an identifiable maintainer consumer. Lean #16490 is a reasonable public runner-up, but its reported consequence is lower and it already has a reproducer and proposed fix. External submission remains separately human-gated.

Reuse Arena #350 as prior exposure and an oracle, not as a discovery claim. Reuse rpylean's checked metadata and existing test framework. Do not create a cross-checker matrix, general framework or new corpus package for this bounded repair.

The exact source, public candidate, honest control and local patch workflow are feasible. Baseline reproduction belongs inside the repair item. The companion and checked-import package are deliberately deferred for value; CVC, resource and transfer blockers do not enable this repair.

candidates.rationale: Highest-value feasible output: a changed independent checker, direct regression and reviewable patch for a public false-proof boundary. Reproduction is only the baseline; semantic correctness and compatibility of the bounded repair are the decision-changing uncertainties.

Arena and current source already identify the failure and consequence. A standalone reproduction has insufficient incremental value; retain its exact controls and custody requirements as the selected repair's baseline.
No demonstrated decision-changing reader need supports the full companion cost. It does not protect the live rpylean boundary.
No demonstrated consumer need or incremental regression value. Its unrelated known cases do not repair the rpylean recursor boundary.
